The data points (Week 1 through Week 6) show a strong, consistent positive linear association: as advertising spend increases, sales increase. The records and checks support the visual observation of the positive trend (r2) and the absence of profitability data (r1). In a typical business context where a dashboard shows a strong positive ROI signal (spend vs sales), the intended action is usually to continue or expand that trend.
